# L1 Card Template

> L1 is a research index, not a full paper summary. Every reusable claim needs a source anchor.

```yaml
---
title: <FULL_TITLE>
authors: [<first author>, et al.]
year: <YYYY>
venue: <venue | arxiv>
url: <url>
arxiv_id: <id if any>

lane: <project lane>
paper_type: <project-controlled type>
lifecycle_role: <survey-seed | canonical-anchor | strong-baseline | frontier-candidate | background | low-confidence-novelty-risk>

decision_axes:
  axis_1: <project value>
  axis_2: <project value>
  axis_3: <project value>
---
```

## 一句话

≤30 字，说明它在本项目谱系里的位置，不写泛泛摘要。

## 机制表

| 维度 | 本文设定 | 为什么重要 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Problem / setting |  |  |  |
| Core mechanism |  |  |  |
| Training or inference loop |  |  |  |
| Evaluation signal |  |  |  |
| Key design choice |  |  |  |
| Limitation / assumption |  |  |  |

## 核心增量

**事实 [paper brief / PDF anchor]**:

**解释 [本项目判断]**:

- 上游：
- 同期：
- 下游：

## 优缺点

- Strength [paper]:
- Risk [paper 或 本项目判断]:
